description:
The Modular Functional Artificial Limbs scheme was launched by the Government of India in 2016. 

This initiative aims to provide high-quality artificial limbs to individuals with disabilities. 

The scheme is particularly focused on those who have lost their limbs due to accidents, diseases, or congenital conditions. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to enhance the mobility and independence of persons with disabilities. 

The government aims to provide these artificial limbs at no cost to the beneficiaries. 

The Modular Functional Artificial Limbs are designed to be lightweight and easy to use. 

They are also customizable to suit the specific needs of each individual. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India is the primary agency responsible for manufacturing these limbs. 

The scheme targets individuals aged 18 years and above. 

However, there are provisions for younger individuals in special cases. 

Eligibility for the scheme is determined based on the degree of disability. 

Individuals with a disability of 40 percent or more are eligible to apply. 

The income limit for applicants is set at Rs. 2 lakh per annum. 

This income criterion ensures that the benefits reach those who are economically disadvantaged. 

The application process involves several steps. 

First, applicants must fill out a registration form available on the official website. 

They must provide personal details such as name, age, and address. 

Next, applicants need to submit proof of disability. 

This proof can be in the form of a disability certificate issued by a competent authority. 

Additionally, applicants must provide proof of income. 

This can be a salary slip, income tax return, or any other relevant document. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the designated authorities. 

If approved, beneficiaries are called for a fitting session. 

During this session, the artificial limb is customized to fit the individual’s requirements. 

The fitting process includes adjustments to ensure comfort and functionality. 

The limbs provided under this scheme are modular in design. 

This means they can be easily modified or upgraded as needed. 

The government has set a target to provide artificial limbs to at least 50,000 individuals annually. 

As of 2023, the scheme has successfully provided limbs to over 200,000 beneficiaries. 

The disbursement of artificial limbs occurs throughout the year. 

There are no specific deadlines for applications as the scheme operates on a rolling basis. 

Beneficiaries can expect to receive their artificial limbs within three months of application approval. 

The Modular Functional Artificial Limbs are equipped with advanced technology. 

They are designed to mimic the natural movement of limbs. 

This enhances the user’s ability to perform daily activities independently. 

The limbs are also designed to be durable and require minimal maintenance. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from beneficiaries. 

Many have reported significant improvements in their quality of life. 

The government regularly conducts awareness programs about the scheme. 

These programs aim to reach out to potential beneficiaries in rural and urban areas. 

The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment collaborates with NGOs for outreach. 

This collaboration helps in identifying individuals who may benefit from the scheme. 

The scheme also includes provisions for follow-up support. 

Beneficiaries can access maintenance services for their artificial limbs. 

This ensures that the limbs remain functional over time. 

The government has allocated a budget of Rs. 100 crore for the scheme in the fiscal year 2023-2024. 

This funding is aimed at expanding the reach and improving the quality of services. 

The Modular Functional Artificial Limbs are available in various sizes and designs. 

This variety ensures that individuals of different ages and body types can find suitable options. 

The limbs also come with different functionalities tailored to the user’s lifestyle. 

For example, there are options for sports enthusiasts. 

These limbs are designed to withstand rigorous physical activity. 

The scheme has been instrumental in promoting inclusivity. 

It encourages individuals with disabilities to participate in society actively. 

The government has also partnered with international organizations for technical support. 

This collaboration aims to enhance the design and functionality of the limbs. 

The Modular Functional Artificial Limbs scheme is part of a broader initiative. 

This initiative focuses on the empowerment of persons with disabilities in India. 

The government is committed to ensuring that all citizens have access to necessary support. 

The scheme aligns with the United Nations Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities. 

This convention emphasizes the importance of accessibility and inclusion. 

The success of the Modular Functional Artificial Limbs scheme is evident in its growing popularity. 

Many beneficiaries have shared their success stories publicly. 

These stories highlight the transformative impact of receiving artificial limbs. 

The government continues to monitor and evaluate the scheme’s effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is actively sought to improve services. 

The Modular Functional Artificial Limbs scheme represents a significant step forward. 

It addresses the challenges faced by individuals with disabilities in India. 

By providing high-quality artificial limbs, the government is fostering independence. 

This scheme is a testament to India's commitment to social welfare. 

It exemplifies the government's efforts to create a more inclusive society. 

The Modular Functional Artificial Limbs scheme is a crucial resource for many. 

It empowers individuals to regain mobility and improve their quality of life. 

The ongoing support and development of this scheme will continue to benefit many in the future.
